answer_1.quote: As an important topic in conversational AI, open-domain human-machine conversation is gaining increasing attention from both academia and industry.

answer_2.quote: In automatic evaluation, besides BLEU-4 and perplexity, we follow (Serban et al., 2017) and employ Embedding Average (Average), Embedding Extrema (Extrema), and Embedding Greedy (Greedy) as metrics.

answer_4.quote: we randomly sample 500 dialogues from each of the three test sets, and recruit 3 native speakers as human annotators.
answer_4.guideline: The annotators judge which response is better based on informativeness, consistency, and fluency of the responses.
